facts.answer: After the remote action and blob clients migrate to the new SDK types, requests carry metadata when the configuration is non-empty and do not add fields when it is empty, and all dependencies on legacy homedir state are removed. The configuration entry is [remote] BuildID in .plzconfig (Go Remote.BuildID); for Execute RPC, the build.bazel.remote.execution.v2.requestmetadata-bin header encodes v2 RequestMetadata, and correlated_invocations_id equals the current BuildID. Unset or empty values do not produce a non-empty associated ID; ordinary tool/action metadata is allowed. Old ID must not carry over between requests. help buildid explains the remote build identifier; no exact spelling is required in the body text.

answer_policy: This colleague owns compatibility behavior for one real caller on a specified version. First look at the caller's version, usage, and user-visible results. If the material is insufficient, ask follow-up questions about "caller, version, support and rejection boundaries"; hand service-internal state to the relevant maintainer, and keep adoption scope within this role.
